defect_summary: Follow-up to BFF-GOVERNANCE-EVIDENCE-REDACTION-SWEEP-001, whose independent reviewer recorded two out-of-contract findings: (1) the same discarded-identity pattern exists in control_loops/router.py (9 handlers call _read_identity(authorization) and discard the return value) and in core/app_factory.py's inline settings handlers (2 handlers call extract_identity(authorization) and discard it); (2) GovernanceService.committee_projection returns linked_evidence unredacted on the committee detail route despite already receiving identity as a parameter. This task audits all 9 control-loops handlers plus the 2 settings handlers plus the committee detail route, redacts every surface whose response structurally carries evidence-ref-shaped content (including canonical OODA packet audit_refs and nested stage bundles, as well as committee synthesis_summary and service_handoff evidence/audit references), and documents why the remaining surfaces carry none.

surface_audit.status_after_fix: redacted via shared redact_ooda_packet_items() across top-level audit_refs, evidence_refs, and all nested stage bundles after in-router pagination slicing; meta.redacted_evidence_count added (scoped to the returned page only); preserves visibility for authorized holders and fails closed when capabilities unresolvable

surface_audit.reason: Structurally schema-enforced: no code change can make this list surface leak evidence content because the response_model already strips any such field. Left discarding identity per acceptance rule 4; verified live against a populated fixture that does carry evidence_refs on the underlying store record (test_v5_interventions_list_baseline_response_model_strips_evidence_refs).

surface_audit.evidence_location: settings_store.py::_validate_settings_bundle only requires the eight top-level section dicts (general/trading/notifications/risk/ai/data/security/featureFlags) to be present as dicts; it accepts any additional top-level field, so an evidence_refs list mixed into the bundle (whether seeded directly or written through POST /api/v1/settings) is not rejected and round-trips unchanged through settings_store.get()
surface_audit.status_before_fix: CORRECTED FINDING (independent review of PR #5988 head 2d9ef040f): identity extracted then discarded; a prior evidence.json revision incorrectly recorded this surface as NO_OP_DOCUMENTED on the mistaken premise that the schema forbids extra top-level fields, but SettingsStore._validate_settings_bundle only checks for the required section keys and does not reject extras. Independent review reproduced the leak live: a real SettingsStore in a temp dir with evidence_refs=[{ref_id: review-only-metric, type: metric}] mixed into the bundle, mounted through the real create_settings_router, returned that ref unchanged (HTTP 200) to a Bearer op-clc-1:operator identity lacking metric.read.
surface_audit.status_after_fix: get_settings now redacts a top-level evidence_refs field via the shared redact_evidence_field_items() helper (same helper the control-loops routes use) and adds meta.redacted_evidence_count to the response; fail-closed verified

Added the wrapper (safe_redact_evidence_refs), generic top-level list-field redaction helper (redact_evidence_field_items), canonical OODA packet redactor (redact_ooda_packet), and paginated OODA packet list redactor (redact_ooda_packet_items) to models.py.

regression_coverage_added.harness: Builds create_control_loops_router(), create_governance_router(), and create_settings_router() directly (never imports main), wired exactly like core/app_factory.py: redact_evidence_refs=models.redact_evidence_refs, capabilities_for_identity=auth.policy.capabilities_for_identity, extract_identity=auth.policy.extract_identity. Read-store doubles supply canonical production-shaped fixture rows (OodaLoopPacket shape with Observe/Orient/Decide/Act/Learn bundles and audit_refs; CommitteeRecord with linked_evidence, synthesis_summary.evidence_refs, and service_handoff evidence/audit refs). A _call_with_supported_kwargs() helper filters constructor kwargs by the live signature so the test file runs unmodified against an unmodified base checkout.
coverage: OODA packets list + detail: low-capability identity redacts metric/job evidence_refs, audit_refs, and learn.postmortem_refs, while observe.incident_refs remains visible to the operator identity holding risk.incident.read; full-capability identity sees exact original unredacted references across all bundles; fail-closed test asserts all refs withheld when capabilities cannot be resolved.

v5 intervention detail: low/full-capability pairs plus a fail-closed test.
v5 interventions list: baseline test proving InterventionRecord's fixed Pydantic schema strips evidence_refs at the wire regardless of identity or capability.

Control-room aggregate: low-capability identity redacts embedded intervention and sentinel evidence_refs (4 total across both embedded lists) while full-capability identity sees both sets fully visible and redacted_evidence_count==0.

Loop inventory detail baseline: fetches a real loop_id from the populated list response and requests its detail directly.
Downstream-health baseline: injects a monitor double returning populated data.

Settings get/export: low-capability identity redacts mixed evidence_refs in SettingsStore bundle while unrelated sections stay intact; full-capability identity sees original unredacted evidence_refs; fail-closed tests for both GET /api/v1/settings and GET /api/v1/settings/export (six tests total).

Governance committee detail: low/full-capability pairs plus fail-closed test covering linked_evidence, synthesis_summary.evidence_refs, service_handoff.evidence_refs, and service_handoff.audit_refs with aggregate count; plus direct GovernanceService.committee_projection regression test.

acceptance_notes.fail_closed: Confirmed by test_ooda_packet_detail_fails_closed_when_capabilities_unresolvable, test_v5_intervention_detail_fails_closed_when_capabilities_unresolvable, test_committee_detail_fails_closed_when_capabilities_unresolvable, test_settings_get_fails_closed_when_capabilities_unresolvable, and test_settings_export_fails_closed_when_capabilities_unresolvable -- when capabilities_for_identity raises, safe_redact_evidence_refs() substitutes an empty capability set and fail_closed_redacted_refs() withholds every capability-gated ref.
acceptance_notes.never_widens_disclosure: No change to models.redact_evidence_refs, EVIDENCE_CAPABILITY_MAP, or any role/capability mapping in auth/policy.py; only route handlers/service methods that previously discarded identity or skipped redaction now route their payload through the pre-existing canonical redactor.
acceptance_notes.no_duplicate_symbols_or_routers: The fail-closed capability-resolution wrapper and OODA redactors exist in exactly one place (models.py); governance/router.py delegates to safe_redact_evidence_refs. No new router, store, or fallback path was created; no symbol is defined twice.
acceptance_notes.redaction_after_pagination: Verified for GET /bff/ooda/packets (dedicated multipage test) -- redaction is applied to response['items']/response['data'] after in-router page slicing, not to the full unpaginated dataset.
acceptance_notes.bff_final_007_shape_match: Every withheld ref in this task's tests asserts redacted:true, required_capability, reason=="insufficient_capability", and each fixed surface's meta reports redacted_evidence_count -- produced entirely by models.redact_evidence_refs/RedactedEvidenceRef.
acceptance_notes.list_vs_detail_verified_separately: list_v5_interventions and its sibling detail route were audited and tested independently, surfacing the genuine structural difference between them (response_model-enforced schema on list route vs. raw pass-through on detail route).

cross_router_and_residual_gaps.in_scope_and_fixed: All 9 acceptance-listed control-loops surfaces, both app_factory settings surfaces, and the governance committee detail route were audited; every surface carrying evidence-ref-shaped content was redacted, every surface without one was verified against a populated baseline and documented as NO_OP_DOCUMENTED.
cross_router_and_residual_gaps.no_further_discarded_identity_evidence_s: GET /bff/v5/sentinel/findings (the list route, not in the acceptance contract) already threads identity through for tenant scoping and is out of this task's declared scope; not modified.
